drhp.business: The Company manufactures aluminium extrusion products, producing 13,325 MT during FY 2025-26 against 13,433 MT in the previous year. It serves OEMs and industrial customers across sectors such as infrastructure, electrical, transportation, defence, engineering, packaging, irrigation and marine, positioning itself as an engineering partner that translates customer requirements into reliable solutions rather than a commodity profile supplier.
drhp.expansion: The Company operates an integrated manufacturing facility at Kharagpur with an installed extrusion capacity of 15,000 MTPA, described as providing the flexibility and precision to serve diverse customer needs. A brownfield expansion at the same Kharagpur site is ongoing and is expected to add 9,000 MT of capacity; management describes it as central to the Company's future agenda, aimed not only at adding tonnage but at strengthening manufacturing flexibility, service capability and readiness to serve more specialised applications in the next phase of demand.
